mission: Re-run event boundary evaluation against the new D2-07 event-bounds gold (12 records: 7 stroke events, 5 explicit non-events) on the integrated branch; report recall, bounds error, contact-inside rate, false-positive rate on non-events; forensics for every miss.

configuration.matching: one-to-one greedy by overlap fraction, target-owner gold outranks other-owner (proposals are target-body proposals); PROPOSED_OK = overlap ≥ 0.5 of gold span OR gold contactMs inside proposal ±60ms (D06 oracle criterion); proposal reuse disclosed, never silently double-counted
